goals: Define the gates required before production track entry.
Keep the v1 internal dashboard usable for internal operators while production remains blocked.
Document read-only gateway prerequisites without connecting to any live system.
Record that the current real operator environment is expected to have only 1 real agent.
Keep 8-agent mock / fixture / gateway-stub lifecycle data quarantined from operator truth.
Preserve environment separation, safety flags, and manual approval requirements.

phases.title: Phase P1: Read-only production gateway contract review
phases.requiredOutcome: Gateway response shape, source status, audit event shape, fallback behavior, and read-only constraints are reviewed before any live connection.

phases.title: Phase P2: Security and secrets architecture
phases.requiredOutcome: Secrets, runtime config, environment separation, and browser exposure rules are approved outside the frontend scaffold.

phases.title: Phase P3: Auth / RBAC production design
phases.requiredOutcome: Real auth and RBAC design is reviewed; current dashboard remains simulation only.

phases.title: Phase P4: Read-only production gateway dry run
phases.requiredOutcome: Future dry run plan is approved with read-only GET-only endpoints and fallback behavior.

phases.title: Phase P5: Monitoring and incident response ownership
phases.requiredOutcome: Monitoring owner, rollback owner, and incident response owner are assigned.

phases.title: Phase P6: Controlled mutation design, future only
phases.requiredOutcome: Controlled mutation architecture remains out of scope until separate approval.

phases.title: Phase P7: Production deploy plan, future only
phases.requiredOutcome: Production deployment remains disabled until an approved deployment plan exists.

entryGates.title: Internal v1 tag exists
entryGates.evidence: v1.0.0-internal tag is present before Sprint 21A planning.

entryGates.title: Security/privacy audit reviewed
entryGates.evidence: Requires manual reviewer sign-off before production track entry.

entryGates.title: Read-only gateway contract approved
entryGates.evidence: No live gateway connection is configured in this sprint.

entryGates.title: Environment separation approved
entryGates.evidence: Production URLs, secrets, deployment path, and access model require manual approval.

entryGates.title: Fixture Quarantine + Single Agent Truth Alignment
entryGates.evidence: Production track must not assume 8 real agents; current operator truth is expected to be 1 real agent.
